name: Top 2026 Web Design Trends video
principles: Treat trends as ingredients and select only those that clarify the subject.
limitations: Playback returned black frames; themes came from metadata and a textual recap, not frame-by-frame observation.

name: Awwwards websites directory
principles: Search references by genre, composition, media, typography, interaction, and mobile behavior rather than award badge alone.
limitations: The directory is broad listing metadata; individual behavior requires inspection.

name: Mobbin popular sites
principles: Tag references by the section or design decision they solve, not only by industry.
limitations: A PRO gate limited accessible coverage beyond four visible examples.

name: Mobbin iOS latest
principles: Give focused tasks explicit state and progress, a large primary action, and secondary decisions in sheets.
limitations: The study records visible taxonomy and examples, not exhaustive app coverage.

name: Mobbin iOS popular
principles: Combine one dominant value or state with predictable lists and contextual sheets.
limitations: Persistent tab bars fit multi-destination products, not every marketing page.

name: Mobbin iOS top
principles: Give one task generous vertical room, keep progress visible, and place the next action near the thumb.
limitations: Transfer task clarity to mobile websites without cloning native chrome.

name: Superpower
principles: Lead with felt outcome, then alternate human trust, clinical proof, mechanics, and price.
limitations: Heavy image, video, and SVG use requires lifecycle control; overlays competed for the first mobile viewport.

name: Seed
principles: Pair clinical evidence with warm material cues and support both uncertain and high-intent visitors.
limitations: Promotion and cookie layers prevented a clean full-phone audit.

name: Biograph
principles: Atmosphere may establish trust, but medical meaning must survive without canvas.
limitations: Hold gestures need explicit keyboard and touch alternatives; media and device-pixel-ratio costs must be capped.

name: Tines
principles: Build a recognizable graphic system around authentic product evidence and preserve two distinct conversion intents.
limitations: Collage overflow, marquees, and looping media require containment and pause controls.

name: Shopify Editions Winter 2026 - Renaissance
principles: A world-building metaphor can organize a large catalog when semantic categories remain immediate.
limitations: The multi-second entry produced extended black frames and needs skip, reduced-motion, and static alternatives.

name: Shopify Editions Spring 2026 - Everywhere
principles: Keep text and navigation independent of a concept-critical WebGL scene.
limitations: Cap device pixel ratio, pause hidden scenes, provide a static fallback, and do not delay LCP or deep links.

name: Shopify Editions Summer 2025 - Horizons
principles: Bake expensive atmosphere into media where possible and keep the release catalog independent of optional play.
limitations: Ambient loops should stop offscreen, and an optional game cannot replace the catalog.

name: Shopify Editions Summer 2024 - Unified
principles: Preserve an ordinary index beside spatial spectacle for different attention budgets.
limitations: The mobile capture remained black during entry even though semantic content was exposed.

name: Shopify Editions Winter 2024 - Foundations
principles: Use CSS perspective and pre-rendered cards, then recompose desktop stages into vertical mobile scenes.
limitations: Scaling absolute desktop coordinates is not an adequate mobile treatment.

name: Shopify Editions Winter 2023 - Built to Last
principles: One narrative illustration can be mnemonic and informational when backed by a semantic chapter list.
limitations: Image coordinates cannot be the only navigation, and detail should load lazily.

name: Shopify Editions Summer 2022 - Connect to Consumer / B2B
principles: Re-run hash positioning after hydration and preserve scroll margin for anchored chapters.
limitations: The animated introduction did not visually honor the supplied deep link; B2B content was verified semantically.

name: Parker
principles: Let one subject-specific brand object change state across semantic chapters.
limitations: The long page, sticky regions, sequence imagery, video, and duplicated breakpoints increase restoration, focus, and motion costs.

name: Contra Labs
principles: Use generative media as evidence and pair each canvas with a DOM explanation or poster.
limitations: The intro blocked bounded inspection, semantic landmarks were weak, and all canvases remained on mobile.

name: Basement
principles: Back canvas environments with posters and conventional content, and start audio only by request.
limitations: The desktop canvas appeared empty while mobile rendered; overlays require focus and escape discipline.

name: Cofounder
principles: Embed authentic platform state in one coherent world and art-direct responsive raster assets.
limitations: Horizontal overflow appeared at 390 pixels, and the image and SVG inventory was large on a very long page.

name: FOLLOW.ART
principles: Use a brief glyph introduction and build cropped wordmarks as responsive text.
limitations: The inspectable DOM reported about:blank, so downstream motion, semantics, and counts were not asserted.

name: Zipline
principles: Provide immediate posters, pause offscreen media, and art-direct media for the device.
limitations: The desktop route remained on a loader during bounded inspection; consent UI must fit the phone viewport.

name: MANA yerba mate
principles: Preload a sparse sequence, fetch later frames near intent, and keep a static first frame with labeled controls.
limitations: The fixed intro hid content, many controls lacked useful labels, and a frame sequence was inferred rather than directly observed.

name: Floema
principles: Make scroll states read as chapters and provide a normal stacked reduced-motion version.
limitations: Pins should be shorter on phones, media should decode lazily, and canvases should pause.

name: House of Honey
principles: Let expressive type and imagery carry identity while preserving native scrolling.
limitations: Pointer-only behavior must be disabled on touch and reduced motion.

name: PP Neue Montreal
principles: When typography is the subject, variation settings and comparison can become useful interaction.
limitations: Pinned media needs poster frames and static final-state specimens for reduced motion.

name: Bucks Sauce
principles: Product folklore can unify typography, objects, and interaction while commerce actions remain outside animated layers.
limitations: Many assets and seven canvases require consolidation and inactive-scene pausing.

name: JoyRush
principles: Keep the item and primary action central in the portrait crop and reserve media dimensions.
limitations: A delayed discount modal blocked scrolling; overflow and third-party asset duplication need control.

name: Izanami
principles: Do not gate semantic content on GPU success; provide timeout, skip, and immediate reduced-motion output.
limitations: The preloader remained at zero, the main visual experience did not appear, and mobile was not directly observed.

name: Glitch&Grit
principles: Decode only current and adjacent media, with a still list for reduced data and motion.
limitations: The route exposed 26 videos plus multiple animation and smooth-scroll libraries.

name: Hiroto Sato
principles: Use a strict loader timeout, a poster fallback, device-tiered rendering, and conventional DOM navigation.
limitations: The loader continued beyond thirteen seconds; the final scene and mobile final state were not verified.
